title: policy.json: feedback
description: Feedback about HITLd (design part 18.4). Filing feedback in HITLd's public repository is an external publication, so it goes through the send gate. Changing who approves is the owner's decision.

approvers.description: Who may approve publishing a feedback record: "owner", or contributor IDs. Until team use is designed (HITLD-44), each person approves only their own feedback and that person is the owner.
